# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are provided for the latest 1.x release. Earlier versions are not supported.

| Version | Supported |
| :-----: | :-------: |
|   1.x   |    Yes    |
|  < 1.0  |    No     |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Report vulnerabilities privately through GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/balinomad/simple-config/security/advisories/new).

Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability. Include the affected version, a description of the impact, and steps to reproduce if available. Reports will be acknowledged and investigated as soon as possible.
